title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

Most times, we appeal players that have been banned for hacking in 6-8 months. Since you did indeed hack and you have admitted it, you will still remain banned. This is because you must face the consequences for your actions, like every other player does when they get a valid ban for hacking.

You may next create an appeal regarding this situation in 4 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Fouled
